title: Tunisian Kebabs with Provolone Cheese
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab dish inspired by Tunisian cuisine, served with melted provolone cheese.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine red bell pepper, onion, zucchini, Tunisian olives, and cherry tomatoes.
In a small bowl, mix together Tunisian spice blend and olive oil.
Add the spice blend mixture to the vegetables and toss to coat.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread slices on the grill.
Once the kebabs are cooked, serve with toasted pita bread and melted provolone cheese.
Optional: add ablaze to the kebabs for an extra spicy kick.
